method: Every expectation below was written from 571 IAC chapter 96 (IAC 5/14/25) and Iowa Code 2026 §481A.48 before any case was run against North Ground, with each place placed in its state by the U.S. Census Bureau's TIGERweb state service queried on 2026-10-01 (point-in-state, and whether a 500 m circle around the point lies wholly in the state). Iowa publishes no small-game units, so no case names a zone: the answer is the state's statewide rule or it is not. A case that disagrees is a finding, never an expectation to edit.

cases.law: On 15 November both the regular season (96.1(1), last Saturday in October to 10 January: 3 cocks daily) and the falconry season (96.9(3)(a), 1 October to 31 March: 2 pheasants, either sex) are open, with different limits, so the answer turns on whether the hunt is by falconry.

96.1(1): cock pheasants from the last Saturday in October (31 October 2026) to 10 January 2027, 3 daily and 12 in possession, entire state open. Des Moines is more than 500 m inside Iowa on the Census boundary.
The regular season opens on the last Saturday in October, 31 October 2026, and the youth weekend (24–25 October) has passed; outside an open season §481A.48(1) prohibits taking pheasant.
96.1(3): the weekend preceding the last Saturday in October (24–25 October 2026) is a youth hunt for residents only, so residency decides the answer.
96.1(3): resident youth 15 or younger, accompanied by an adult 18 or older; 1 cock daily, possession 2 after the first day.
Only the youth may shoot on the youth weekend (96.1(3)), and the regular season has not opened.
96.9(3)(a) and (4)(a): falconry season for pheasant (both sexes) 1 October to 31 March; 2 daily, no more than 1 a hen; 4 in possession.
The regular season closed on 10 January 2027 (96.1(1)).
96.3: bobwhite quail from the last Saturday in October to 31 January, 8 daily and 16 in possession, entire state open.
96.2: gray partridge opens on the second Saturday in October, 10 October 2026.
The day before the second Saturday in October.
96.6: cottontail from the Saturday before Labor Day (Labor Day is 7 September 2026, so 5 September) to 28 February; 10 daily, 20 in possession.
96.9(3)(b) and (4)(b): falconry for squirrels from 1 September; 4 daily, 8 in possession. The regular season (96.8) opens 5 September.
96.7: jackrabbit, continuous closed season. Only falconry has a jackrabbit season (96.9(3)(a)).
96.4(1) opens ruffed grouse only north and east of a highway line, a geography North Ground does not hold. The state boundary must not stand in for it, so no answer is given in either direction.

mentions: within about 500 m of the state line

cases.law: Census places the point in Iowa, and a 500 m circle around it reaches Illinois, so the statewide answer stands with the state line stated beside it.

cases.place: Rock Island, Illinois, across the Mississippi
cases.law: Census places the point in Illinois. Iowa's statewide rules do not reach it, and North Ground certifies no Illinois rule.
